name: File Shelf
author: KigoJomo
description: Your files, one edge away. Hover the screen edge or click the bar icon to open a real Nautilus window. Browse, search and drag files with your usual file manager, then return to work as the shelf retracts. Reopen the same folder whenever you need it. Choose a left, right or bottom shelf, with saved monitor placement and scratchpad support. Built for Omarchy 4 with Hyprland and Nautilus. No accounts or background network requests.

barWidget.description: Open, retract, and position the Nautilus file shelf
